title: 아직 안 죽었어
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Rock with heavy J-Rock influences. Distorted electric guitar rhythm tracks playing palm-muted eighth notes and open power chords. Lead electric guitar performs melodic counterpoints and a bright, overdriven solo. Electric bass follows the kick drum with driving root notes. High-energy acoustic drum kit with a prominent snare on 2 and 4 and consistent eighth-note hi-hat patterns. Energetic male tenor vocals with slight grit during the chorus. Tempo is 165 BPM in the key of E Major. 4/4 time signature. Production is polished with modern compression and bright EQ on the guitars and vocals.
suno_analysis_lyrics:

[distorted electric guitar riff, driving drums, bass enters]
